contact.name: Amber Denis
contact.designation: Equine Assisted Personal Development Coach and Facilitator
contact.evidence_quote: Amber Denis ... In 2019 I added Facilitator to my title allowing me to work with corporate groups and events. I have my certification as an Equine Assisted Personal Development Coach and Facilitator. With these certifications I can bring my love and passion for horses to people. Nothing gives me more hope and joy then having someone else experience the true empathy that horses can portray to us.

alternates.name: Karen Stephen
alternates.evidence_quote: Karen Stephen ... In March 2025, I became a Certified Equine Assisted Learning (EAL) Coach through EAL Canada, combining my passion for helping people with the powerful lessons and connections that horses can provide. Through equine-assisted learning, I support individuals in developing self-awareness, confidence, emotional regulation, communication skills, and personal growth.
alternates.why_chosen: Other role. Karen Stephen is a certified EAL coach and team member at Equi-Soul.
